import re

n = input()

# Replace first 'at' (not at start) with '@'
def replace_first_at(s):
    match = re.search(r'(?<=.at)', s)
    if match:
        pos = match.start() - 1
        return s[:pos] + '@' + s[pos+2:]
    return s

n = replace_first_at(n)

# Replace all 'dot' (not at start) with '.'
def replace_all_dots(s):
    while True:
        match = re.search(r'(?<=.dot)', s)
        if not match:
            break
        pos = match.start() - 1
        if pos < 1 or pos > len(s) - 3:
            break
        s = s[:pos] + '.' + s[pos+3:]
    return s

n = replace_all_dots(n)

print(n)
